2. Saṃtoṣād abhivyaktasukhasyānuttamatve smṛtim udāharati-- tathā coktam iti / Kāmasukhaṃ
laukikaviṣayebhyaḥ sukhaṃ divyaṃ saṃkalpamātrotthaviṣayajam, Saṃkalpād evāsya pitaraḥ
samuttiṣṭhantu ityādiśruteḥ / Tṛṣṇākṣayābhibhavyaktasukhasyety arthaḥ / Videhakaivalye tu
sukhavākyāni duḥkhanivṛttyā gauṇānīti /
